event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis bounce, energy fades, Fed risk priced hawkish.
Oct manufacturing PMI printed 56.0 vs 55.5 fc and Dallas Fed 13.4 vs 9.8 prior, and that macro resilience plus SOXX +2.85% drove a narrow tech-led rebound that reversed a 20d -12.30% semi drawdown; with all FOMC odds at hike 100.0% for Oct 28, positioning is defensive into the decision and the tape rewarded hard assets over duration-sensitive groups.

INDICES — VIX 18.4 below its 16.6 20-day MA; low-fear tape.
SOXX +2.85%, QQQ +1.11%, SPY +0.71%, IWM +0.45%, DIA +0.31%. Large > small by 0.60pp, so the bounce was mega-cap-led, not broad. Most notable cross-asset move: USO -1.95% while TLT +0.42% and GLD +0.33% — oil weakness offset by duration bid. No 200-DMA breaks flagged.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 0.9x, QQQ 0.9x: neither confirms conviction.
Gaining indices SOXX 1.1x and QQQ 0.9x are low-conviction accumulation; losing IJH 0.8x and IWM 0.6x show distribution-lite in mid/small. XLC 1.4x and XLRE 1.2x are gaining attention while XLU 0.4x and XLV 0.9x are being ignored. Breadth: 59% >50DMA, 58% >200DMA, A/D 281/218, up/down vol 1.29, 26 new highs vs 20 lows — participation confirms, not diverges, the index move.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +1.69%, XLI Industrials +1.42%, XLY Discretionary +1.03%, XLRE Real Estate +0.54%, XLE Energy +0.45%, XLF Financials +0.21%, XLB Materials +0.14%, XLV Healthcare +0.00%, XLU Utilities -0.02%, XLP Staples -0.34%, XLC Comms -1.57%.
Top industries SOXX +2.85%, SMH +2.74%, DRAM +2.70%, ITA +2.44%; bottom DBA -0.97%, IBIT -1.61%, USO -1.95%, ICLN -2.93%.
Biggest 5d inflows XLP +413mm (90p) and XLK +392mm (79p); biggest outflows XLU -883mm (0p) and XLF -806mm (15p), so flows partly contradict the price ranking — leaders XLK/XLRE are absorbing capital, but defensive XLRE and utilities are bleeding. Money-in goes to semis (SOXX +5326mm, SMH +2533mm at 100p) and megacap tech; money-out of IWM -2446mm and GLD -2243mm. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — Protection bid elevated, not complacent.
SPY PCR 2.05 and QQQ 2.70 signal heavy put demand; QQQ skew +12.4% shows real downside premium. VIX 18.4 sits above the 16.6 20d MA, yet VIXEQ 42.3 vs VIX 18.4 is a wide gap — a high-dispersion, stock-picker/rotation tape rather than a macro-correlated one.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil down, dollar up: USO -1.95% against a 20d +10.81% run, with UUP +0.17% squeezing commodity longs.
HYG +0.19% and TLT +0.42% bid alongside the semi bounce is a mild risk-on signal, but SLV -0.12% and 20d -11.45% shows metals still leaking. Next FOMC Oct 28 — CME FedWatch prices hold 0.0% / cut 0.0% / hike 100.0%, a fully-priced hike; Polymarket Dec 25bp hike 75% YES, 5d -4pp.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 54.2, neutral.
Top movers TSLA +5.21%, LMT +5.13% on 2.1x volume, GEV +4.92%, IJT +0.71% on 7.2x volume. Momentum: XLK best sector 20d-wise is actually XLE at +12.14%, while XLC is worst at -6.59%. TL;DR watch XLK, XLE, and SOXX for continuation.

Watch tomorrow: SOXX +2.85% — vol 1.1x on a rebound after 20d -12.30%, needs follow-through; GLD -2.67% 20d with PCR 0.60 — flow imbalance; IJT 7.2x volume spike on +0.71% — small-cap signal.
